$comment: Scoring configuration placeholder. Kept in the data layer (not in UI code) so it can change without touching components (SRS NFR-009, Appendix A ScoringConfig). STATUS IS DRAFT pending product-owner approval. Overall score uses a Wilson 95% lower confidence bound so small random samples cannot claim the same confidence as a large sample; raw score and answered count are also shown. The implementation is in lib/scoring.ts and must stay in sync with this file.

unanswered.proposal_position: Idea proposal: untouched items count as not experienced after a per-category confirmation prompt (FR-008). SRS leaves this open.

overall_score.source: MVP fairness adjustment: 95% Wilson score lower bound; raw percentage and answered count shown alongside.
overall_score.notes: N/A excluded from denominator; explicit not-experienced stays in it. The adjusted score is a conservative estimate, not the user's literal percentage.

era_affinity.note: Era-ineligible dataset fallback is active (FLG-DS-02). Each experienced multi-era item contributes 1 / number_of_non_neutral_era_tags to each tagged era; total contribution remains one. This is the SRS §6.3 fractional-allocation option, pending OD-05 approval.

weights.policy: Equal weighting recommended per SRS §6.4 (OD-06). All items currently carry weight 1.0.

result_labels.constraints: Labels must be non-shaming, must not derive from birth year, and must not present one era as superior (SRS §6.7, §2.4).
